messages:
Alice Nguyen: Quick sync — we're gating a DevEx release window and need to lock owners + deps. Target final cut: EOD Monday. Owners I propose: SDK -> Carlos, Docs -> Priya, Samples -> Tom. Dependencies: eng-runtime API change (maybe breaking), eng-sre infra config. Can everyone ack and call out blockers?

Carlos Mendez: Ack. SDK RC build is on CI but Windows tests are failing (PR #1423). I'll ping reviewers and try to get a hotfix in today.

Priya Shah: Docs freeze policy reminder: I need final doc content 48h before cutoff. I'm aiming to finish reviews by Sun 12:00 UTC. Also please add 1-line changelog items here so I can consolidate.

Tom Becker: Samples team — I'll update the node + python quickstarts for the new init API, but I need the RC package version. @Carlos can you publish an RC tag today so I can update package.json and build samples?

Carlos Mendez: Planning to publish RC at ~16:00 UTC. CI flaky on Windows so I might publish a linux/mac RC and note windows tests as flaky for now. I'll leave a clear note in PR.

Samira Patel: QA plan: we'll run smoke suite + manual auth flow after RC publish. Estimated ETA: 6h after RC is published. If there's a patched build earlier, we can run a smoke pass sooner.

release-bot: Pipelines: artifacts/redwood-sdk/rc-2026.04.0 queued (triggered by Carlos Mendez). Status: queued.

Alice Nguyen: Changelog cutoff is 23:00 UTC on Sunday. If you have changes that must be listed, post a 1-line summary + PR link in this thread. I'll compile entries into CHANGELOG.md and add author attributions.

Priya Shah: Adding a proposed changelog line: "Docs: quickstart updated to async init + config examples" — PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/891

Tom Becker: I'll add sample PRs once Carlos publishes RC. Plan to mark reviewers as devex@redwood for faster turnaround.

Carlos Mendez: Note in PR #1423: skipping Windows integration for RC publish (tests flaky). Will re-enable once eng-runtime patch lands. Leaving test tags so QA can target stable paths.

Samira Patel: QA checklist (to be copied into test run ticket):
```
- smoke: generate + chat end-to-end
- quickstart-node: run sample quickstart and confirm token auth
- quickstart-py: run sample server and call /generate
- perf: local p95 < 120ms baseline check
- regression: previous breaking PR list validation
```

Alice Nguyen: Please react with :thumbsup: if you can meet the times. If you foresee a blocker, DM me. I'll post consolidated owners + links by 18:30 UTC.

Priya Shah: :thumbsup:

Tom Becker: :thumbsup:

Samira Patel: :thumbsup:

Carlos Mendez: :thumbsup: (will update PR with publish timeline)

release-bot: artifact published: https://artifacts.internal/redwood-sdk/rc-2026.04.0 (status: success)

Alice Nguyen: Thanks all — I'll stitch changelog + owners and ping eng-sre + eng-runtime owners for the infra/compat checks after lunch.
